subject.title: feat(discord): add canvas-first Discord Activities support

question: Should Discord Activity support be accepted with this PR's core Canvas/Gateway auth bypass and root config shape, or reworked under the Canvas plugin with stronger Activity auth and bundled SDK loading?
rationale: The PR changes public Activity auth, config/defaults, browser code execution, token transport, and WebSocket fanout, while current main has moved Canvas ownership into the bundled Canvas plugin.

options.title: Rework before merge
options.body: Move Activity config/auth/HTTP behavior into the current Canvas plugin contract, make Activity access credentialed, bundle the SDK, and refresh the branch against main.

options.title: Accept current risk
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly approve the root config, optional-token auth bypass, CDN SDK loading, URL token transport, and fanout behavior as intentional.

options.title: Pause for related branch
options.body: Park or close this PR if the overlapping Discord canvas branch becomes the canonical implementation path.

recommendation.title: Rework before merge
recommendation.body: Move Activity config/auth/HTTP behavior into the current Canvas plugin contract, make Activity access credentialed, bundle the SDK, and refresh the branch against main.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Canvas plugin-surface refactor and recent Discord component/gateway wiring changes that frame the owner-boundary decision.
